sn56.52:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave pokkharaṇī paññāsa yojanāna āyāmena paññāsa yojanāni vitthārena paññāsa yojanāni ubbedhena puṇṇā udakassa samatittikā kākapeyyā
sn56.52:1.4: katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ. yaṃ vā kusaggena ubbhataṃ yaṃ vā pokkharaṇiyā udakanti.
sn56.52:1.5: etadeva bhante bahutaraṃ yadidaṃ pokkharaṇiyā udakaṃ appamattakaṃ kusaggena udakaṃ ubbhataṃ
sn56.52:1.6: saṅkhampi na upeti upanidhampi na upeti kalabhāgampi na upeti pokkharaṇiyā udakaṃ upanidhāya kusaggena udakaṃ ubbhatanti.
